hook: Human 5S rDNA units come in two methylation states, and the low-methylated ones are more open
hook_turn: and the low-methylated ones are more open
summary: Long-read sequencing of complete human 5S rDNA arrays shows each unit is either low or high in methylation. Low-methylation units are more accessible and carry fewer nucleosomes, and the pattern is shared among apes. The data come from a limited set of genomes and cell lines, and the link to chromatin is an association.
title: Long-read analysis of complete human 5S rDNA arrays reveals a zoned organization with two-state unit methylation linked to chromatin architecture
